listing.name: Targeting Feed Slowdown Fix v1.1
listing.summary: Fixes rendering slowdown issues with the Targeting Feed system on certain graphics cards.
listing.aiSummary: Fixes rendering slowdown issues with the Targeting Feed system on certain graphics cards.

description:
This is a small quality of life mod that fixes the rendering slowdown issue some graphics cards have with the Targeting Feed system of the Heron. It will remove the shield glow effect but maintains the weapons glow aboard shielded fighters to preserve visual identification when the system is active.

Download Version 1.1

aiDescription: Fixes a performance issue that causes slowdowns when using the Targeting Feed system on some graphics cards. Removes the shield glow effect to improve performance while preserving weapon glow on shielded fighters for visual identification. Maintains the system's functionality without compromising key visual cues.
